versions.content: Period for periodic triggering A Trigger can optionally de- fine a period for periodic triggering. It is expressed via the meta-class Multidimen- sionalTime in terms of time or angle. Note that the main use case for this is to specify the properties if the trigger is coming from the Basic Software e.g. from a Complex Driver, it is not used as an input for the RTE generator.
